what: The Age Calculator works out an exact age in years, months and days from a date of birth. It also shows the age as total months, total weeks and total days, and how many days are left until the next birthday.

It helps anyone filling in forms, checking school or job age rules, planning birthdays, or just curious about how many days old they are. You can find the age today or on any other date, such as an exam date or a cut-off date for an application.
The calculation runs in your browser, so the dates you enter stay on your device.
uses: Get your exact age in years, months and days for applications that ask for it.
Set the second date to an exam or deadline date to see if someone is old enough or too old on that day.
See how many days are left until the next birthday.
Find out your age in total days or weeks, for example to celebrate your 10,000th day.
Use it for a child, a pet, a company or a building, starting from any date.
tutorial: Click the “Date of birth” box and pick or type the date. On most devices a calendar opens when you click.
The “Age on this date” box is filled with today’s date when the page opens. Leave it to get the age today.
Change the second date if needed
To get the age on a different day, change “Age on this date” to that day. It can be in the past or the future.
The “Age” box shows the result as years, months and days, for example 36y 3m 5d. Results update as soon as both dates are filled in.
“Total months”, “Total weeks” and “Total days” show the whole age in a single unit. Weeks are whole weeks only.
“Next birthday in” shows the number of days until the next birthday after the second date, or “Today!” if it is the birthday.
features: Full months are counted first, then the days left over, the same way ages are counted on official documents.
The second date is editable, so you can check an age in the past or the future.
See the age as total months, total weeks and total days.
Shows how many days remain until the next birthday.
Birthdays on 29 February and month ends are clamped to the last day of shorter months.
Results change as soon as you change either date. There is no button to press.

example.title: Worked example: born on 15 August 1990
example.text: Enter 15 August 1990 as the date of birth and 20 November 2026 as the second date. The “Age” box shows 36y 3m 5d: 36 full years take you to 15 August 2026, 3 more months to 15 November 2026, and 5 days are left to 20 November. “Total months” is 435 (36 × 12 + 3). “Total days” is 13,246 and “Total weeks” is 1,892, because 13,246 ÷ 7 = 1,892 with 2 days left over. “Next birthday in” shows 268 days, counting to 15 August 2027.

tips: The second date starts as today. Change it only when you need the age on another day.
Total weeks is rounded down to full weeks, so a few extra days are not shown in that box.
For someone born on 29 February, the birthday is counted on 28 February in years that are not leap years.
You can also use it to measure time between any two dates. Put the earlier date first.
If your browser shows dates as month/day/year, check the order carefully before you read the result.
problems: One of the two dates is empty or incomplete. Fill in both dates fully.
“Date of birth must be before the other date.”
The date of birth is later than the second date. Check the year, or swap the dates.
The age is one day different from another site
Sites count leftover days in different ways, especially around month ends. This tool counts full months first, then the days left over.
Next birthday shows a number like “1 days”
This is the correct count. When the birthday is tomorrow the tool shows 1 days.
